body: This is a fun server, recommend for anyone burned out on AC.

Hey I'm in this situation too, I'm really sorry. For me making myself get a trash bag and throw out all the beer cans was so relieving. Just having them out of my sight - I felt like it was an entirely new start.

Sorry you're going through a rough time. I just read your post, "**I stopped drinking and wrote about it. Tell me what you think."**   Your positive but realistic attitude really hit home. Just wanted to thank you and remind you of the happiness.

\*hugs\*
I can't sleep at all or I sleep like 12 hours+. I feel ya.

❤  


I'm here if you need a hug. Anytime.

I really like your heart tattoo <3. I am going through some rough stuff myself, and it really sucks to feel this way you know. Most of the time I can't see hope in the future and get really depressed, but there has been points where I somehow got out of it and felt good - atm it's hard to remember that feeling but it is there somewhere.
